qualification_policy.authority: Actual user instruction in this session: proceed without interactive human review, only automated tests; human review after implementation is complete (IMP-10), using GitHub issue follow-up bug-fix/improvement sessions.
qualification_policy.historical_human_evidence: preserve original outcomes, candidate bindings and actual acceptance; no fabricated or relabelled pass
qualification_policy.action_and_runtime_approvals: unchanged; automated qualification does not waive actual scope/action authorization or product-runtime human authority

transitions.guard: scope/action authorization and current automated-qualified or still-valid historical accepted predecessor evidence
transitions.effect: record exact authority reference; no inferred installation/deployment permission

transitions.guard: reviewable integrated candidate, declared mandatory automated checks and rollback prepared
all mandatory applicable automated checks actually passed against current candidate; no unrun required check or unresolved blocking control defect; dependency evidence current
transitions.effect: record candidate-bound automated evidence and limitations; defer human review until after IMP-10; no human acceptance receipt or broader action authorization

transitions.guard: failed or unrun required automated check, or blocking defect with evidence
transitions.effect: record failure and assign correction; do not count deferred human-only review as a failed automated check

transitions.guard: existing authorization covers changes; dependencies/current baseline valid

transitions.effect: invalidate affected automated evidence and rerun relevant checks; retain history without requiring a per-stage interactive review

transitions.guard: actual action-authorization/resource/authority/defect blocker with evidence; deferred human-only review is not an implementation blocker
transitions.effect: record affected capability/options; continue independent authorized work

transitions.guard: blocker resolved; actual scoped authorization and current predecessor evidence valid

transitions.effect: preserve evidence and reconcile uncertain effects; no destructive cleanup by inference

legacy_state_handling.ready_for_demo: Reconcile the current candidate/evidence as ready_for_qualification; no automatic pass.
legacy_state_handling.awaiting_human: Retain the historical record and resume evidence reconciliation as ready_for_qualification; missing interactive review no longer blocks qualification.
legacy_state_handling.accepted: Preserve actual historical human acceptance and its exact scope; it may satisfy a dependency only while its candidate binding remains valid.

qualification_check: Automated qualification requires actual current passing evidence. A generated receipt, deferred human review or elapsed time is never a pass.
human_review_followup: After IMP-10 automated qualification, use GitHub issue follow-up sessions with issue-bound reproduction, fix, automated regression evidence and actual focused human observations where needed.
